source: opcodes.md §8 / A22-0526-3 pp.15, 16, 36, 53 and §5.2; cross-checked against 223-2588-2 p.24
note: SEVEN latches — three arithmetic, four compare. 'Six' in this project always means ChannelStatus, which is a different set and is not here. The carriage channel-9 / channel-12 indicators arrive with the 1403 in Phase 2 and are not latches of this set.

latches.name: arithOverflow
latches.label: Arithmetic overflow
latches.setBy: Add and Subtract ONLY (one-field or two-field), when the result exceeds the limit set by the B-field word mark — the carry is lost
latches.resetBy: the test that reads it, or computer reset

latches.name: zeroBalance
latches.label: Zero balance
latches.setBy: Add, Subtract, Multiply, Zero and Add, Zero and Subtract producing a zero balance
latches.resetBy: the next arithmetic op (any except Divide) that does not give a zero balance; computer reset; power-on reset

latches.name: divideOverflow
latches.label: Divide overflow
latches.setBy: Divide — quotient field two or more positions too small, an improperly addressed dividend, or division by zero (always)
latches.resetBy: the test that reads it, or computer reset

latches.name: compareHigh
latches.label: Compare high (B > A)
latches.setBy: Compare, Table Lookup, Branch if Character Equal
latches.resetBy: the next Compare / Table Lookup / BCE

latches.name: compareEqual
latches.label: Compare equal (B = A)
latches.setBy: Compare, Table Lookup, Branch if Character Equal
latches.resetBy: the next Compare / Table Lookup / BCE

latches.name: compareLow
latches.label: Compare low (B < A)
latches.setBy: Compare, Table Lookup, Branch if Character Equal
latches.resetBy: the next Compare / Table Lookup / BCE; computer reset turns this ON

latches.name: compareUnequal
latches.label: Compare unequal
latches.resetBy: the next Compare / Table Lookup / BCE; computer reset turns this ON

citations.arithOverflowSetBy: A22-0526-3 p.53 (1415 Console, 'Overflow' light), identical wording in editions 2 and 3: 'The overflow condition can be detected only during an add or subtract operation, and not during a zero and add, zero and subtract, multiply or divide operation.'
citations.divideSetsZeroBalance: A22-0526-3 p.53 'Zero Balance' light text enumerates the setting ops as 'any add, subtract, zero and add, zero and subtract, or multiply operation' — divide is absent from both the set and the reset lists, matching the p.16 rule.
citations.indexingSetsArithOverflow: A22-0526-3 p.15 — indexing does not set arithmetic overflow even if the index addition overflows.
citations.computerReset: A22-0526-3 p.36 — computer reset turns off the overflow indicators and the zero-result indicator, and turns ON the low-compare and unequal-compare indicators.
citations.equalOnceOffCannotComeBackOn: opcodes.md §5.2, 223-2588-2 p.24 — once equal is turned off during an operation it cannot be turned back on.
